propositions: When a single criterion's evidence run exhausts its budget (LLMBudgetExhaustedError, RunawayToolLoopError, or token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError), the per-criterion loop in _recover propagates the error and aborts the entire recovery instead of preserving partial evidence.

The finalizer must receive all N criteria evidence entries even when some runs exhaust; exhausted criteria should carry content-free placeholder entries that prevent them from being scored as affirmative verdicts.
Recovery should only fail outright (raise CompletionRecoveryError) if all criteria fail to produce evidence, not if a subset exhaust their budgets.

Non-token UnretryableOutputError exceptions from evidence runs should still propagate and fail recovery immediately, distinguishing them from token-exhaustion failures that are recoverable per-criterion.
